description: This file contains various Lua functions designed to test the limits of the Lua interpreter, such as memory overflows, excessively long identifiers, too many instructions, and other resource limits. It appears to be a test script for assessing Lua's handling of boundary conditions and errors.

methods.name: teststring
methods.description: Tests Lua's handling of overly long strings and string length overflow.

methods.name: loadrep
methods.description: Creates a chunk with a large string repeated and loads it to test memory limits.

methods.name: controlstruct
methods.description: Creates and loads a very long control structure to test instruction length limits.

methods.name: manylines
methods.description: Loads a chunk with an excessive number of lines to test line limits.

methods.name: hugeid
methods.description: Attempts to load a chunk with an overly long identifier to test lexical element size limits.

methods.name: toomanyinst
methods.description: Loads a chunk with too many instructions.

methods.name: loadrepfunc
methods.description: Loads a function with many constants or instructions to test resource limitations.

methods.name: toomanyconst
methods.description: Loads a function with too many constants.

methods.name: toomanystr
methods.description: Creates a large string to test memory and string length limits.

methods.name: toomanyidx
methods.description: Creates a large table with many indexed elements to test index limits.
